title: Dispatch a Companion visibility command to the Control API

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0081 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-25 directive 'dale al merge y a lo que sigue' after CHG-0079 and CHG-0080 merged — the third slice of the REQ-INT-002 Companion adapter, completing the command-dispatch step of AC-018. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0081.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors, SPEC-0001 REQ-INT-002 / US-010 AC-018, and the 2026-08-25 user directive.

claims.statement: CHG-0080 built the request but did not send it. The minimal increment to make a command take effect is not the full runnable Companion module (connection config, button callbacks, packaging), but a thin executor that dispatches the built request and interprets the response. Injecting the transport keeps the executor free of any particular HTTP client and testable without a live server.
claims.evidence: companion/src/command.ts produced only a ControlApiRequest; server/src/routes/deviceControl.ts is the command endpoint.

claims.statement: executeVisibilityCommand(transport, baseUrl, token, request) sends the built request as method+url (baseUrl+path) with Authorization: Bearer <token> and Content-Type application/json and the JSON body, then translates the server envelope: a 2xx { data: { command } } becomes { ok: true, outcome } carrying the ProductionCommandOutcome, and an { error: { code, message } } body or any non-2xx status becomes { ok: false, status, code, message }. The device Bearer credential is the only auth the route accepts; the executor dispatches and interprets but does not retry.
claims.evidence: companion/src/transport.ts against server/src/routes/deviceControl.ts (Bearer auth, { data } success and { error } failure envelopes).

claims.statement: Injecting a transport that records the outgoing call and returns a canned Control API response proves the executor forms the correct authorized HTTP request (method, url, Bearer header, JSON body) and maps a success envelope to the command outcome and an error envelope to a typed failure — the AC-018 command-dispatch contract — without needing a live server.
claims.evidence: companion/tests/transport.contract.test.ts composes the builder with executeVisibilityCommand over an injected transport and asserts both the sent request and the parsed result.

claims.statement: This is a headless executor with an injected transport, not a runnable Companion module: no InstanceBase, no button callbacks, no connection configuration, no fetch-backed transport, and no retry or backoff. A fetch-backed transport, the Companion module packaging, the AC-018 state-feedback half, and the Take/trigger catalog extension remain deferred (.frontier nodes companion-adapter-runtime-module, companion-adapter-feedback, companion-catalog-take-trigger-actions). Additive to the @overlaykit/companion package; no server, protocol, or Studio source changed.
claims.evidence: companion/src/transport.ts (transport is a parameter, no network client); the .frontier companion nodes.

successCriteria.statement: The executor sends the built request to the Control API with the device Bearer credential and returns the command outcome on success.
successCriteria.verification: companion/tests/transport.contract.test.ts asserts the outgoing method, url, Authorization header, and body, and that a 2xx { data: { command } } yields { ok: true, outcome }.

successCriteria.statement: A Control API error is surfaced as a typed failure, not a thrown or swallowed error.
successCriteria.verification: A test asserts a 409 { error: { code, message } } yields { ok: false, status: 409, code, message }.

successCriteria.statement: No existing behavior regresses and the adapter stays dependency-isolated.
successCriteria.verification: npm run check and npm run build pass across all workspaces; companion depends only on @overlaykit/protocol.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0081 records the executor-not-module scope and the deferred fetch/module/feedback/catalog residuals before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: executeVisibilityCommand dispatches the built request with Bearer auth and maps the response envelope to a typed result.
A contract test proves the sent request and the success and failure mappings over an injected transport; the full check passes.
